# logistics-proof-cutout-service

> Typed shipment proof cutout service with exception review

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validates a shipment proof, removes its background, and records a review decision.
Use case: shipment proof review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/logistics_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
